items.title: Aaron and Miriam
items.charge: Speaking against Moses; challenging his authority

items.title: Adoni-bezek
items.charge: Mutilating seventy kings

items.title: Ahaz
items.charge: Burning his children in the fire; copying the altar of Damascus; sacrificing to the gods that smote him

items.title: Asa in his latter years
items.charge: Hiring the king of Syria against Israel; imprisoning the seer who reproved him; seeking to the physicians and not to the Lord

items.title: Caiaphas and the council
items.charge: Seeking false witness against Christ; condemning him by night; delivering him to the Gentiles; forbidding the apostles; stoning Stephen

items.title: David and Bathsheba
items.charge: Adultery and the arranged death of Uriah

items.title: Elymas the sorcerer
items.charge: Withstanding the apostles; seeking to turn the deputy from the faith

items.title: Gideon's ephod
items.charge: Making an ephod from the spoil; Israel whoring after it

items.title: Jehoshaphat's alliances
items.charge: Joining affinity with Ahab; going to Ramoth-gilead with him; joining with Ahaziah to make ships

items.title: Jehu
items.charge: Executing the house of Ahab, then keeping the calves of Jeroboam

items.title: Jephthah's vow
items.charge: A rash vow, and its performance on his daughter

items.title: King Solomon
items.charge: Multiplying foreign wives; building high places to their gods

items.title: Moses, and the Egyptian in the sand
items.charge: Slaying an Egyptian and hiding him in the sand

items.title: Nazareth, his own country
items.charge: Being offended at him; seeking to cast him down the hill

items.title: Nebuchadnezzar
items.charge: Pride: is not this great Babylon, that I have built?

items.title: Rehoboam
items.charge: Forsaking the counsel of the old men; forsaking the law of the Lord

items.title: The magistrates of Philippi
items.charge: Beating and imprisoning uncondemned Romans on the word of a mob

items.title: The manna hoarders
items.charge: Keeping manna overnight; going out to gather on the Sabbath

items.title: The seven sons of Sceva
items.charge: Exorcising in the name of Jesus whom Paul preacheth

items.title: The traders in the temple
items.charge: Making the house of prayer a den of thieves

items.title: The young mockers of Bethel
items.charge: Mocking the prophet of the Lord

items.title: Uzziah
items.charge: Entering the temple to burn incense, which belonged to the priests

items.title: Zacharias
items.charge: Not believing the words of the angel Gabriel, and asking for a sign
